text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 Alert — Elevated 5xx rate detected on dedicated-cluster-42 for tenant NimbusRetail. 5xx rate rose from ~0.2% to 6.5% in the last 3m. Endpoints affected: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Auto-paging to #incidents.

oncall-anna: I'm taking this. @sre-ryan @eng-runtime-miguel can you join?

sre-ryan: on it. grabbing logs and metrics now. initial check: backend latency and gateway 502s.

eng-runtime-miguel: pulling runtime dash. seeing KV cache thrash on nodes in pool dedicated-cluster-42, lots of kv.eviction events + gpu_util approaching 95% on several hosts.

platform-janet: I can spin up burst nodes in that pool (has reserved capacity headroom). starting scale-up to +4 G4x instances. will take ~90s to register.

cs-lead-sam: Customer (NimbusRetail) reporting timeouts and 502s for last ~10m. They're seeing errors in production — they want ETA and mitigation.

acct-liz: pinged customer: asked if they can tolerate short redirection window to backup pool. waiting on confirmation.

oncall-anna: while we scale, can we throttle tenant at edge to reduce noisy neighbor effect? prefer soft throttle first (reduce concurrency) rather than full cutoff.

eng-runtime-miguel: agree. adding per-tenant token bucket: limit NimbusRetail to 25 rps and concurrency 8 for now. policy applied to gateway rule id: gw-tn-7192.

ops-bot: Policy gw-tn-7192 deployed to 3 routers in us-west-2.

sre-ryan: looking at pod logs: repeated "kv_get: miss -> load -> evict" cycles and RPC backpressure:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:42Z runtime INFO tenant=NimbusRetail kv_eviction key_count=91203 evict_batch=1024
2026-03-15T09:12:44Z runtime WARN tenant=NimbusRetail rpc_timeout backend=encoder-3 err=deadline_exceeded
```

eng-runtime-miguel: kernel traces show GPU tensor uploads spiking, long tail latency on model shards. likely noisy model stage that pins memory and thrashes KV cache.

platform-janet: burst nodes are registered, autoscaler reports pool size +4. beginning live reroute of 10% traffic to dedicated-backup-1 (quantized model variant allowed).

oncall-anna: applying reroute now: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/release/reroute -d '{"from":"cluster-42","to":"dedicated-backup-1","pct":10}'`

ops-bot: Reroute request accepted. control-plane job 0x8f3 queued.

cs-lead-sam: Customer approved 10% reroute and throttle. thanks. asking for status updates every 10m.

sre-ryan: after throttle + reroute, 5xx rate dropped from 6.5% -> 2.1% in 2m. KPIs improving but still elevated on embeddings endpoint. investigating prioritization mismatch in batching.

eng-runtime-miguel: discovered long-running embeddings jobs from tenant are monopolizing batch slots. deployed temporary per-tenant batch size cap and lowered max_batch_latency to favor smaller jobs.

oncall-anna: applied cap: tenant.batch_max_size=8 for NimbusRetail.

eng-runtime-miguel: immediate impact: emb latency median down 35%, 5xx for embeddings down to 0.6%. generation 5xx at 1.1%. overall 5xx ~0.9%.

platform-janet: also saw a handful of hosts reporting ephemeral OOMs on worker process. I've drained two suspect nodes for investigation and pinned them out of rotation.

sre-ryan: creating a temporary quota for NimbusRetail to limit total token throughput to 4M tokens/min to avoid repeat saturation until we root cause.

acct-liz: customer accepted the temporary quota, appreciates the proactive updates.

eng-runtime-miguel: captured heap and KV stats; likely causes: tenant working set grew unexpectedly (experimental feed) combined with model shard memory pressure. plan: increase KV capacity for that tenant, tune eviction thresholds, and add tenant-aware cache sizing.

oncall-anna: summarizing for handoff to SRE second shift:
- Incident TS: 2912345678
- Customer: NimbusRetail (Dedicated cluster-42)
- Impact: elevated 5xx/timeouts for ~17m peak, customer-facing timeouts for ~10m, partial reroute and throttling applied
- Current status: stabilized; 5xx down to ~0.3% after mitigations; burst nodes + reroute + per-tenant throttle in place
- Actions taken: throttle (25rps, concurrency8), batch cap (8), reroute 10% to backup pool, drained 2 nodes, added +4 burst nodes, temporary token quota
- Owners: eng-runtime-miguel (postmortem), sre-ryan (follow-up mitigation), platform-janet (node/drain work)

sre-ryan: taking over for follow-up. will monitor for 1h and collect traces/logs. creating ticket INF-5821 for KV sizing + autoscale threshold changes.

eng-runtime-miguel: postmortem owner acked. early RCA hypothesis: noisy tenant workload + undersized KV and conservative autoscale thresholds -> cache thrash -> GPU memory churn -> request timeouts.

cs-lead-sam: Customer notified of resolution and asked for RCA and preventive items. scheduled 1:1 with their ops tomorrow.

acct-liz: will send post-incident customer note and include mitigation steps performed.

ops-bot: Incident marked mitigated at 2912349200. Incident duration: ~23m.

oncall-anna: closing thread and leaving follow-ups in INF-5821. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

eng-runtime-miguel: quick TODOs in ticket: increase tenant KV allocation, implement tenant-aware batching isolation, lower autoscale thresholds for dedicated pools, add synthetic load tests simulating high embeddings churn.

sre-ryan: will include timeline & metrics for postmortem. planning blameless review.

acct-liz: noted customer impact: ~3% of requests had 5xx and ~1% experienced client-visible timeouts.

cs-lead-sam: good job all, let's ensure follow-through.
